description: This source file contains automated test cases for validating the creation, signing, and correctness of FIT images and Image Tree Sources (ITS) within the OpenEmbedded/Yocto project environment. It defines multiple test scenarios, each configuring the build environment, invoking BitBake, and analyzing generated files to verify correct image generation, signing, and expected field contents.

classes.name: FitImageTests
classes.description: A test suite class inheriting from OESelftestTestCase that implements multiple methods to verify FIT image generation, signing, and correctness, including tests for both Linux and U-Boot images, as well as signature validation and configuration correctness.

methods.name: test_fit_image(self)
methods.description: Verifies that FIT images and their associated Image Tree Sources are created successfully and contain expected key fields such as description, type, load address, entry point, and kernel/ramdisk references.

methods.name: test_sign_fit_image(self)
methods.description: Checks whether the FIT image and ITS are created, properly signed, and contain correct signature metadata, including signature algorithm and signature length, specifically for Linux-based images.

methods.name: test_uboot_fit_image(self)
methods.description: Performs similar validation as test_sign_fit_image but for U-Boot FIT images, verifying creation, signature presence and correctness, and key fields.

methods.name: test_uboot_sign_fit_image(self)
methods.description: Validates signed U-Boot FIT images where both U-Boot and Kernel images are signed, ensuring signatures are present and signature metadata matches expectations.

methods.name: test_sign_cascaded_uboot_fit_image(self)
methods.description: Validates a scenario where both U-Boot proper and Kernel images are created and signed in a cascaded manner, verifying signature correctness and presence.

methods.name: test_initramfs_bundle(self)
methods.description: Verifies the configuration, creation, and content correctness of initramfs bundle nodes within the FIT ITS, including hash verification and configuration fields.

calls: extracting signature info from dumpimage output
